problem_type: A production React module called a shared class combiner without importing its binding, so rendering the paid-card accessory crashed the workbench chunk.
symptom: The generate-remaining and stop-midway Electron walks waited for the paid-card title, but the workspace showed 工作台加载失败; renderer console reported ReferenceError: cn is not defined while rendering AgentPanelV4SpendCardBody.
direct_cause: AgentPanelV4SpendCardBody.tsx used cn(...) for the exclusion button className after the interactive restore change, but the module had no cn import.
class_root: The production render boundary had no regression test that mounted every newly introduced shared helper binding in the paid-card body, so a missing module import reached the runtime chunk.
affected_population: All Electron users who opened a paid Agent card after the restore accessory change
The generate-remaining and stop-midway real-App walks on macOS

invariant_owner_layer.why: The paid-card body is the shared render boundary for the exclusion accessory; its focused static-render test mounts that boundary and exercises the helper binding.

internal_only_reason: This is an internal TypeScript/React module binding invariant; no external protocol or dependency decides it.
invariants: Every identifier used by AgentPanelV4SpendCardBody's production render is imported or locally declared.
The exclusion accessory renders in the real paid-card body without throwing before the card title can mount.
generality_proof: The fix restores the module binding at the shared paid-card body render boundary, and the regression mounts the same component path that crashed in Electron. The repository-wide cn search found no other changed production module with a missing cn import; all other cn callers have an explicit import or a local declaration.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the shared pointer face consumed by the paid-card body; the body must mount this boundary and all of its imported render helpers without runtime binding failures.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The component now imports cn and the focused static-render test exercises the exclusion button className.
It already imports cn explicitly and its existing component tests render the same pointer accessory family.
It already imports cn explicitly; the workspace crash stack resolves to the paid-card body accessory, not the slot shell.

recurrence.reason: A missing import can recur whenever a JSX module gains a new helper call without a matching binding, and runtime chunk boundaries can hide the defect until that surface mounts.
same_class_scan: rg -n '\bcn\(' src/workbench/ai src/workbench — checked all current cn callers and verified explicit imports/local declarations.
git show d58276026 — identified the exact change that introduced cn(...) into AgentPanelV4SpendCardBody without the import.
The focused static-render test mounts ExclusionToggle through AgentPanelV4SpendCardBody, covering the reported path rather than only the pure projection.

prevention.invariant: The production paid-card body and its exclusion accessory must mount successfully while producing the expected data attribute and class contract.
prevention.failure_mode: A missing binding fails the focused render test before the change can be accepted; the Electron walk then verifies the original chunk boundary.
prevention.strategy: Keep a focused component render test beside the shared paid-card body and run it with the changed Vitest slice plus the real Electron walk.

legacy_paths.rationale: No obsolete render path or data migration exists; the change restores the missing binding on the current component.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is an application module import omission and is independent of dependency versions.

migration: No persisted data or caller migration is needed; the existing paid-card component continues through the same render path.
residual_risks: The full stop-midway and generate-remaining walks still need to be rerun after rebuilding the Electron renderer.
The original two title failures may reveal further behavior issues after the chunk crash is removed.
